name: Host Metrics
description: Per-core CPU (including steal), memory, disk and per-instance CPU, memory, players and frame timing for every game host, kept for 30 days in a small SQLite file on the host by a low-priority collector service, with a capacity verdict (how many more instances the host takes). The collector is installed on every host at host setup; use Apply to host after an addon update or a settings change. The host menu entry Host Metrics has the host switch, the status and Apply to host; the Host Metrics page lists every host. On a QLSM core with notifications, host problems also appear under the navbar bell and the page gets a Hosts health navbar entry.

global.label: Notify from severity (info, warning or critical)

global_settings.description: Event thresholds (pushed to the collector on a host with Apply to host or its next host setup; Update Plugins does not apply them), the capacity verdict knobs and the notification switches (used by the QLSM backend only, they take effect at once). Whole numbers: percents 0-100, seconds and milliseconds 1-3600.

fields.label: Event window (seconds)
fields.description: A condition must hold this long before it becomes an event (disk, OOM and instance changes are reported at once).

fields.label: Notifications under the bell
fields.description: Host problems (late frames or a saturated core with players on, high steal, low memory, OOM kills, a full disk, a host unreachable for over 5 minutes) appear under the bell in the navbar. Needs a QLSM core with notifications; an older core ignores this.

fields.label: Notify from severity
fields.description: Lowest severity that reaches the bell. No problem is reported as info, so info behaves like warning for now.
